ei.title: Christine and Leo at the Vet

fullPassage: Christine was a cat owner who loved her furry companion, Leo. One morning, she noticed that Leo was not feeling well. Concerned for her beloved cat, Christine decided to take him to the animal hospital. As she always brought Leo to this hospital, she was certain that the vet knew well about Leo. She desperately hoped Leo got the necessary care as soon as possible. The waiting room was filled with other pet owners. Finally, it was Leo's turn to see the vet. Christine watched as the vet gently examined him. The vet said, \u201CI think Leo has a minor infection.\u201D \u201CInfection? Will he be okay?\u201D asked Christine. \u201CWe need to do some tests to see if he is infected. But for the tests, it's best for Leo to stay here,\u201D replied the vet. It was heartbreaking for Christine to leave Leo at the animal hospital, but she had to accept it was for the best. \u201CI'll call you with updates as soon as we know anything,\u201D said the vet. Throughout the day, Christine anxiously awaited news about Leo. Later that day, the phone rang and it was the vet. \u201CThe tests revealed a minor infection. Leo needs some medication and rest, but he'll be back to his playful self soon.\u201D Relieved to hear the news, Christine rushed back to the animal hospital to pick up Leo. The vet provided detailed instructions on how to administer the medication and shared tips for a speedy recovery. Back at home, Christine created a comfortable space for Leo to rest and heal. She patted him with love and attention, ensuring that he would recover in no time. As the days passed, Leo gradually regained his strength and playful spirit.

questions.passage: Christine was a cat owner who loved her furry companion, Leo. One morning, she noticed that Leo was not feeling well. Concerned for her beloved cat, Christine decided to take him to the animal hospital. As she always brought Leo to this hospital, she was certain that the vet knew well about Leo. She desperately hoped Leo got the necessary care as soon as possible. The waiting room was filled with other pet owners. Finally, it was Leo's turn to see the vet. Christine watched as the vet gently examined him. The vet said, \u201CI think Leo has a minor __________ (infect).\u201D \u201CInfection? Will he be okay?\u201D asked Christine. \u201CWe need to do some tests to see if he is infected. But for the tests, it's best for Leo to stay here,\u201D replied the vet. It was heartbreaking for Christine to leave Leo at the animal hospital, but she had to accept it was for the best. \u201CI'll call you with updates as soon as we know anything,\u201D said the vet. Throughout the day, Christine anxiously awaited news about Leo. Later that day, the phone rang and it was the vet. \u201CThe tests revealed a minor infection. Leo needs some medication and rest, but he'll be back to his playful self soon.\u201D Relieved to hear the news, Christine rushed back to the animal hospital to pick up Leo. The vet provided detailed instructions on how to administer the medication and shared tips for a speedy recovery. Back at home, Christine created a comfortable space for Leo to rest and heal. She patted him with love and attention, ensuring that he would recover in no time. As the days passed, Leo gradually regained his strength and playful spirit.

questions.passage:
(A) Christine was a cat owner who loved her furry companion, Leo. One morning, she noticed that Leo was not feeling well. Concerned for her beloved cat, Christine decided to take him to the animal hospital. As she always brought Leo to this hospital, she was certain that the vet knew well about Leo. She desperately hoped Leo got the necessary care as soon as possible.

(B) “I'll call you with updates as soon as we know anything,” said the vet. Throughout the day, Christine anxiously awaited news about Leo. Later that day, the phone rang and it was the vet. “The tests revealed a minor infection. Leo needs some medication and rest, but he'll be back to his playful self soon.” Relieved to hear the news, Christine rushed back to the animal hospital to pick up Leo.

(C) The vet provided detailed instructions on how to administer the medication and shared tips for a speedy recovery. Back at home, Christine created a comfortable space for Leo to rest and heal. She patted him with love and attention, ensuring that he would recover in no time. As the days passed, Leo gradually regained his strength and playful spirit.

(D) The waiting room was filled with other pet owners. Finally, it was Leo's turn to see the vet. Christine watched as the vet gently examined him. The vet said, “I think Leo has a minor infection.” “Infection? Will he be okay?” asked Christine. “We need to do some tests to see if he is infected. But for the tests, it's best for Leo to stay here,” replied the vet. It was heartbreaking for Christine to leave Leo at the animal hospital, but she had to accept it was for the best.
questions.stem: 주어진 글 (A)에 이어질 내용을 순서에 맞게 배열한 것으로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: (A) 병원에 데려감 → (D) 대기실, 진찰, 검사 필요, Leo 남김 → (B) 수의사 전화, 결과 통보, Christine 데리러 감 → (C) 약 투여 안내, 집에서 돌봄, 회복. 정답: (D)-(B)-(C)
det.analysis:
✅ ④ (D)-(B)-(C): 시간순으로 자연스러운 흐름
(A) 병원 방문 → (D) 대기/진찰/검사 → (B) 결과 전화/데리러 감 → (C) 집에서 회복
❌ ① (B)-(D)-(C): 전화가 진찰보다 먼저 올 수 없음
❌ ② (C)-(B)-(D): 회복이 진찰보다 먼저 올 수 없음
❌ ③ (C)-(D)-(B): 회복이 가장 먼저 올 수 없음
❌ ⑤ (D)-(C)-(B): 약 투여가 결과 통보보다 먼저 올 수 없음
det.tip: 순서배열: 시간 순서와 대명사/지시어 연결 확인 — (D)의 "tests"가 (B)의 "The tests revealed"로 연결
